# ADR-3063: A06: CVE remediation SLA setting for severity 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Without SLAs, critical CVEs linger.

## Decision

Security configuration SHALL declare a CVE remediation SLA setting for severity 3 (A06-3).

## Consequences

SLA breaches open executive risk tickets.
